```{r}
# Load required libraries
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
rootDir <- "/workdir/coh22/poaceae_tfbs/"
# Load data
metadata <- read.table(paste0(rootDir, "data/Poaceae_metadata_filtered_2025.04.16.tsv"), sep = "\t", header = T)
metadata$complete_plus_duplicated <- metadata$complete + metadata$duplicated
ordered_metadata <- arrange(metadata, complete_plus_duplicated)
# Convert data to long format for ggplot
df_long <- pivot_longer(
  ordered_metadata,
  cols = c(complete, duplicated, fraged, missing),
  names_to = "Category", values_to = "Count"
) %>%
  group_by(assemblyID) %>%
  mutate(Total = sum(Count, na.rm = TRUE),
         Percent = Count / Total) %>%
  ungroup()

# Keep order in the plot
df_long$assemblyID <- factor(df_long$assemblyID, levels = ordered_metadata$assemblyID)
```
Function to make busco-style plot
``` {r}
plot_tabasco <- function(df, text_size = 24) {
  library(ggplot2)
  library(scales)

  ggplot(df, aes(y = assemblyID, x = Percent, fill = Category)) +
    geom_col(width = 1) +
    theme_minimal() +
    labs(title = "",
         x = "Percent of TABASCO genes",
         y = NULL) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("complete"   = "#F5C242",
                                 "duplicated" = "#D47500",
                                 "fraged"     = "dodgerblue1",
                                 "missing"    = "#3B67A4")) +
    scale_x_continuous(labels = percent_format(accuracy = 1)) +
    scale_y_discrete(expand = c(0, 0)) +
    theme(axis.text.y = element_blank(),
          axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
          panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
          text = element_text(size = text_size))
}
```

``` {r}
#Plot all assemblies
all_tabasco <- plot_tabasco(df_long)
ggsave(paste0(rootDir, "results/figs/all_tabasco.png"), plot = all_tabasco, width = 7, height = 8, units = "in", dpi = 1500)
```

``` {r}
# Plot SRA assemblies only
sra <- dplyr::filter(df_long, source == "SRA")
sra_tabasco <- plot_tabasco(sra)
ggsave(paste0(rootDir, "results/figs/sra_tabasco.png"), plot = sra_tabasco, width = 7, height = 8, units = "in", dpi = 1500)
```
